title: Measured deterministic search for fixed-width resolution refutations
claims: ExactBoundedResolutionWidth establishes exact P membership for each fixed-width canonical resolution-refutation language.
MeasuredBoundedWidthRefutationSearch returns a verified canonical refutation exactly when one exists at the fixed width, with no unconditional SAT claim for empty output.
MeasuredResolutionSaturation emits a valid width-bounded newest-first derivation and detects the empty clause exactly at the bounded-width refutation threshold.
FiniteListFixedPoint proves extensional saturation in a number of rounds bounded by the length of a finite ambient list.

experiments.purpose: Bind all archived Lean overlay sources and the recorded exact statements to the local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports its live Lean invocation count, which may be zero.
